definitions.gloss: majority; more than half; the greater part
definitions.explanation: Refers to a quantity exceeding fifty percent. Common in political, statistical, and business contexts.

examples.japanese: {過半|かはん}の{議席|ぎせき}を{獲得|かくとく}した。
examples.english: They won a majority of the seats.

examples.japanese: {参加者|さんかしゃ}の{過半|かはん}が{賛成|さんせい}した。
examples.english: More than half of the participants agreed.

examples.japanese: {売上|うりあげ}の{過半|かはん}を{海外|かいがい}{市場|しじょう}が{占|し}めている。
examples.english: The overseas market accounts for the majority of sales.

notes:
A formal, somewhat literary word for "more than half." Most commonly encountered in the compound {過半数|かはんすう} (majority number), which is the standard word for "majority" in voting and parliamentary contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {過半数|かはんすう}: majority (of votes)
- {過半数|かはんすう}を{占|し}める: to constitute a majority
- {過半|かはん}を{超|こ}える: to exceed half

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {大半|たいはん}: the greater part, most (implies well over half)
- {半数|はんすう}{以上|いじょう}: half or more (more precise, less formal)
- {多数|たすう}: a large number, the majority (not necessarily over 50%)
